title: Management Trainee - Operations
description: Key Responsibilities: Coordinate with warehouse staff to plan the arrival and unloading of delivery trucks and vehicles. Ensure timely and accurate entry of data into warehouse management systems and Excel reports. Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports on stock status, movement, and variances. Keep proper filing and backup of all physical and digital records for internal and external audits. Required Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills Proven warehouse management abilities Problem-solving and contingency planning skills Excellent time management and organizational capability Accuracy in reporting and documentation Leadership and team-building proficiency Preferred Qualifications: Graduate (any discipline) Proficiency in Microsoft Excel Familiarity with inventory management and documentation procedures
